role: Interface for formatting an achievement description at display time; the client installs one on openInventory to insert the inventory key.
scope_reason: The openInventory hint toast shows the formatted description in recorded frames.

members.name: formatString
members.note: the default key 'E' is baked into the string; a rebound key is not honored

notes: Interface only; the implementation is the client's StatStringFormatKeyInv. Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): bindings are pinned. Formerly listed as missing: Formatting with a rebound inventory key; native text is fixed to the default key.
